### deformableParticleInShearFlow3d

This example case contains the benchmark validation case for a 3D deformable particle submerged in a shear flow (cf. [@kruger:2011]).
The solid mechanics for the deformation of the membrane is modelled via the finite element method (FEM) and the shear flow dynamics is simulated via LBM.
Communication between the two solvers is done via the immersed boundary method (IBM), where the flow velocity is used to compute the displacement of the solid nodes, and the resulting force is mapped onto the fluid via the external force field.
The current benchmark case validates the correct operation of the coupled FEM-IBM-LBM solver by comparing the scaled deformation ratio over the normalized time scale, cf. @fig-shearFlow3d.
The mechanical parameters as well as the positioning of the membrane can be configured via the XML files.
Note that this example is not executable with parallelization yet.
